counting_rule: Operator/functional families are deduplicated within each module; dtypes, sizes, language, batch, storage formats and algorithm variants do not create extra operators. At least one explicitly scoped PASSED source profile is required. Cross-module totals may include the same mathematical operation implemented through different library interfaces.
qualification_rule: A verified family proves only its linked PASSED source profiles/required cases, not every API configuration. PARTIAL examples and capability probes are excluded.

cuBLAS.validation_scope: 固定教学profile与所列扩展cases；含复杂rank-k类型化适配、HIP GPU packed转换、FP32分组batched及FP64项目策略调优。rotmg极端缩放使用HIP修正；调优/批量变体按同一数学族去重。

cuBLASLt.validation_scope: 6个profile：原FP32 SGEMM、HSH pointer-array/strided batch，以及B7 HSH grouped分发与SGEMM custom-find/autotune。FP16输入/输出、FP32累加、bias、候选全输出、workspace=0及所选方案重放通过；分发适配不等于原生device-grouped API。

cuBLASMp.validation_scope: 尚无通过整例验收的算子族。

cuDSS.validation_scope: FP64 CSR：原始simple三语言、异构/均匀batch、analysis-only、1000阶GENERAL/双RHS残差；CPU稀疏符号/matching + rocSOLVER CSRRF或项目HIP CSR pivot LU。get_set仅部分配置/查询验收；大例固定pivot、小例分量CSR fill，未外推任意大规模动态pivot。

cuFFT.validation_scope: 10 个 profile：原始单卡/双卡 C2C、实数正逆变换和 legacy/离线 SPIR-V/HIPRTC callback。1D 多卡使用 hipFFT + RCCL + HIP。

cuPQC.validation_scope: SHA-256 单线程与 SHA3-256 的 32-lane 协作 GPU kernel；各 14 输入与 hashlib 精确一致，PQC 其它算法未实现。

cuRAND.validation_scope: 4 种分布 × 9 个 generator = 36 个 profile；原始参数、库内重复性和解析分布矩通过，跨库不要求逐位同序列。

cuSOLVER.validation_scope: 原始FP64教学矩阵；status/info、全量分解/重构、残差、正交性、未排序配对及实际meig检查。B6增加64位LU/三角求逆；SVD/eigen typed接口显式INT_MAX限制。
